unstuck_said.text: Filed Nano-settlement issue #1 on nzdsf2-gif/relayshield-x402-seatbelt-example: "A Nano (XNO) rail removes the gas floor under the spending guard." Argued the budget guard has a gas-costed floor on Base; on Nano the seatbelt can guard down to a fraction of a cent and the emergency stop settles as one final block.
